name: Security Analysis
description: Admin dashboard that compares the site's security-related configuration (SecKit, Login Security, Password Policy, CAPTCHA, Security Review) against a bundled ideal and rates it, with an Excel export.
project_description:
Briefing 
 Security Analysis is a module that audits a drupal project in terms of security parameters and intends to help development team but also leaders and managers in this scope.

It evaluates the security of headers, passwords, website fields helping to

prevent clickjacking, brute-force, XSS, code injection among others types of attacks

based on in-house document Security by Design in a clear, concise and user-friendly page.

 Usage 
 The module can be used on production environments; although it's advised to run on development, integration or quality environments.

The module can be installed using composer require command and it also requires the installation of https://www.drupal.org/project/phpspreadsheet .

 Note: Security Analysis uses the security review module, where the version 3.0.x of security review is supported by 3.0.0-release of security analysis and version 2.0.x of security review is available on 2.0.0-alpha1 of security analysis.
